scoring_justification: Recomputing from raw Cp data is not feasible because the input CSV files are not present in the verifier environment; result‑level comparison against paper‑reported values with appropriate tolerances is the chosen approach.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for T_tr, ΔH_tr, ΔS_tr of KOH and KOD from the paper’s Table III.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: J. Chem. Phys. 89, 4346 (1988), Table III: KOH T_tr=226.7 K, ΔH_tr=222 J/mol, ΔS_tr=0.121 R; KOD T_tr=253.1 K, ΔH_tr=257 J/mol, ΔS_tr=0.1258 R.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values copied exactly from Table III; no transformation.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Direct extraction from a published paper; no synthesis required.

outputs.description: The transition temperature, enthalpy, and entropy for KOH and KOD low‑temperature phase transitions. All values are scalars. T_tr in K, ΔH_tr in J/mol, ΔS_tr in units of the molar gas constant R.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the submitted numeric values to hidden paper‑reported values (Table III) with appropriate absolute tolerances. Full credit is awarded when all values fall within the tolerances; partial credit may be given based on the number of correct values. The choice of baseline (extrapolation from fixed offsets below/above T_tr) is fully specified in the workflow steps.
